attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 2 and the Fire trait to any combat of Perception check. Then roll 1d12. On a 1, banish this card and each character at your location is dealt 1 Fire damage.

If you do not evade this card and fail the check to acquire it, each character at your location is dealt 1 Fire damage.
